note: Nomination-day report for the sixteen divisions of Hillsborough rural district, one member each. Eight divisions received a single nomination and are listed here; in Ballymacbrennan, Ballyskeagh, Breda, Carryduff, Drumbo, Edenderry and Ougley no nomination was made and the retiring members were deemed re-elected; five of them are recorded from Lisburn Standard reports of the council's meetings in August-November 1930 (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). The Lisburn Standard's nominations report (2 May 1930, p. 5) adds Blaris to the divisions with no nomination; Blaris (Samuel Brown) and Breda (James Dick, co-opted for Breda in 1927) are recorded from the August 1930 meeting (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Ballyskeagh remains unnamed: its retiring member Robert Simpson was not seen at the meetings and was replaced by co-option in March 1931. Filed on Friday 30 May 1930, the day appointed by Down County Council for the county and rural district elections (Banbridge Chronicle, 15 March 1930, p. 2); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (provisional) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). division from his co-option for Breda on 7 June 1927, 'as representative of the Breda electoral division in room of the late Mr. A. F. Blakely' (Lisburn Standard, 10 June 1927, p. 3); the meeting report cited names the member as sitting early in the term. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
